# Backend — Evidence

## Findings
<a id="findings"></a>

- <a id="research.backend.e5c8e0f5"></a>**1. The backend directory is a private NestJS application named 'backend' (version 0.0.1, license UNLICENSED) declared in backend/package.json.**
  [`package.json:1-7`](../package.json#L1-L7)
- <a id="research.backend.a9b5c807"></a>**2. backend/tsconfig.json compiles the backend with strict TypeScript checks enabled, experimental decorator metadata, ES2023 target, and output to ./dist.**
  [`tsconfig.json:2-31`](../tsconfig.json#L2-L31)
- <a id="research.backend.150705f1"></a>**3. backend/package.json declares npm scripts for building (nest build), running (nest start, node dist/main), linting (eslint), testing (jest), and TypeORM migrations.**
  [`package.json:8-27`](../package.json#L8-L27)
- <a id="research.backend.ac621e01"></a>**4. backend/fly.toml deploys the backend to Fly.io as app 'schedgen-backend' with primary region 'jnb', building from the Dockerfile, setting PORT=3001, NODE_ENV=production, FRONTEND_URL, 2026 semester dates, and the production Google OAuth callback URL, serving an http_service on internal port 3001 with force_https on a shared-cpu-1x 512mb VM.**
  [`fly.toml:1-38`](../fly.toml#L1-L38)
- <a id="research.backend.45c28ca5"></a>**5. backend/nest-cli.json configures the NestJS CLI with the @nestjs/schematics collection, sourceRoot 'src', and a compiler option that deletes the output directory before each build.**
  [`nest-cli.json:1-8`](../nest-cli.json#L1-L8)
- <a id="research.backend.b213f18f"></a>**6. backend/eslint.config.mjs configures ESLint with the flat config format, applying @eslint/js recommended, typescript-eslint recommendedTypeChecked, and the Prettier plugin, with @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any disabled and warnings for no-floating-promises and no-unsafe-argument.**
  [`eslint.config.mjs:1-34`](../eslint.config.mjs#L1-L34)
- <a id="research.backend.e264cc65"></a>**7. backend/.prettierrc configures Prettier to use single quotes and trailing commas.**
  [`.prettierrc:1-4`](../.prettierrc#L1-L4)
- <a id="research.backend.6b9bdeb3"></a>**8. The production Dockerfile builds the backend in two stages on node:20-alpine, installs only production dependencies, runs as a non-root 'nestjs' user, exposes port 3001, health-checks http://localhost:3001/health, and starts the app with node dist/main.js.**
  [`Dockerfile:1-53`](../Dockerfile#L1-L53)
- <a id="research.backend.5857555d"></a>**9. The development Dockerfile runs the backend on node:20-alpine, installs all dependencies including devDependencies, exposes port 3001, and starts the app with npm run start:dev in watch mode.**
  [`Dockerfile.dev:1-19`](../Dockerfile.dev#L1-L19)
- <a id="research.backend.2dd75891"></a>**10. backend/.dockerignore excludes node_modules, dist, coverage, IDE files, environment files, logs, OS files, git metadata, test files, and README.md from the Docker build context.**
  [`.dockerignore:1-36`](../.dockerignore#L1-L36)
- <a id="research.backend.72bc6afb"></a>**11. backend/package-lock.json is the npm lockfile (lockfileVersion 3) recording the resolved dependency tree for the backend package.**
  [`package-lock.json:1-20`](../package-lock.json#L1-L20)
- <a id="research.backend.e90724d2"></a>**12. backend/tsconfig.build.json extends tsconfig.json and excludes node_modules, test, dist, and spec files from production builds.**
  [`tsconfig.build.json:1-4`](../tsconfig.build.json#L1-L4)
- <a id="research.backend.bd9c3a1e"></a>**13. The jest configuration embedded in backend/package.json runs tests from the src rootDir with the ts-jest transform, matches *.spec.ts files, and writes coverage to ../coverage.**
  [`package.json:84-106`](../package.json#L84-L106)
- <a id="research.backend.e7a20a37"></a>**14. backend/.env.example documents the environment variables the backend expects: server settings (PORT, SESSION_SECRET), PostgreSQL connection, MinIO object storage, Google OAuth, frontend URL, parser service URL, and 2026 semester dates.**
  [`.env.example:1-36`](../.env.example#L1-L36)
- <a id="research.backend.737a298d"></a>**15. The backend's runtime dependencies are the NestJS framework packages (@nestjs/common, @nestjs/core, @nestjs/platform-express, @nestjs/config, @nestjs/swagger, @nestjs/terminus, @nestjs/throttler, @nestjs/passport, @nestjs/axios, @nestjs/cache-manager) plus supporting libraries (axios, cache-manager, class-transformer, class-validator, express-session, form-data, helmet, passport, passport-google-oauth20, pdf-parse, reflect-metadata, rxjs, ts-node, tsconfig-paths, uuid).**
  [`package.json:28-54`](../package.json#L28-L54)
- <a id="research.backend.1d11f4c3"></a>**16. The backend's devDependencies provide the NestJS CLI and schematics, testing tooling (jest, @nestjs/testing, supertest, ts-jest, fast-check), and linting and formatting tooling (eslint, typescript-eslint, prettier, eslint-plugin-prettier).**
  [`package.json:55-83`](../package.json#L55-L83)
